name.en: Denon and Marantz AVR Network Receivers (Rust)

description.en: Control your Denon and Marantz network receivers with Remote Two/3.

value.en:
The integration discovers Denon and Marantz Receivers on the network.

Please note that the integration needs a moment to connect after the remote starts or wakes up.

See the [project page](https://github.com/henrikwidlund/uc-intg-denonmarantz) for requirements, features and restrictions.
